notes: The bill changes only filing-frequency and electronic-filing thresholds, which the model cannot express, and it changes no tax rate, base or exemption. Every new threshold amount is blank in this draft. Section 1 says the intended figures would be roughly $7,320 (monthly) and $3,660 (semiannual) of annual tax liability, but that is a finding, not bill text, so none of it is put in the spec. The effective date is July 1, 2026, which is already past as of today (2026-11-27). The bill would affect how often returns are filed and when payments arrive, not the amount of tax owed, so no revenue estimate follows from it.
